The '''Persuader''', officially known as the '''Model VIII Animal Shock Prod''', was a [[Electroprod/Legends|shock prod]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. A long, narrow rod with a multi-pronged tip, the Persuader had a thick haft on its opposite end that housed its power cell and controls. Equipped with non-slip handgrips on its haft, the prod measured barely over two meters in length and required two hands to wield.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

Used to control large, thick-skinned beasts, the Persuader emitted an electrical charge of [[Stun/Legends|variable intensity]] from a light sting to a powerful discharge, able to get a creature's attention, knock an adult [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] unconscious, or pacify a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. The weapon had to briefly recharge between uses and sold for 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Model VIII Animal Shock Prod was mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
